The '''Grumani''' were orthodox adherents to the [[Children of Mani]] religion.

==Beliefs==
The Grumani believed that moral conduct had to be derived from the directives of [[Mani]], the founder of their religion, as interpreted by Mani's [[Grumani Hierophant|Hierophants]].

==History==
The Grumani split from the breakaway [[Spumani]] in a relgious schism, resulting in a conflict that was fought between the two sects for eight hundred years, until the arrival of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Tenisons between the two groups later cooled to merely mutual disdain.
